audience: customer service teams that answer customers in Kustomer conversations

useCases.title: Look up a customer before you reply
useCases.text: Find a customer by email address. Then list the conversations of that customer and the internal notes on the customer.

useCases.title: Read the history of a conversation
useCases.text: Get a conversation with its status, assignees, tags and priority. Then list its messages with the direction and preview text of each.

useCases.title: Search for conversations by criteria
useCases.text: Search customers, conversations, messages or companies with and or criteria and sorting. Then open a conversation you found.

useCases.title: Tag conversations for follow-up
useCases.text: Add tags to a conversation, or remove tags from it. Missing tags are created, and the other tags stay.

useCases.title: Leave an internal note for the team
useCases.text: Add an internal note to a conversation. The customer does not see the note.
